mentions.name: Home media server
mentions.description: A self-hosted home media server that has served the family's video viewing with no paid streaming subscriptions for 18 months, and became turnkey and low-maintenance a few months ago. It currently runs on Plex, with a planned migration to Jellyfin.
mentions.problem: Replacing reliance on paid streaming services with a self-hosted setup for the family.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My home media server! I’m so rookie compared to many of you, but proud of what I’ve got. We’ve (family) been on it with no paid streaming for 18mo now but it really became turnkey/low
Maintenance a few months ago.

Still on plex, next step is Jellyfin.
mentions.author: Forgeties79
